description: Rung 4 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_PRODUCT_SHELL_DEMO_READINESS_SERIES. Adds frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/ReleaseReadinessBlockerPanel.tsx — a panel that surfaces the active release blockers instead of hiding them. Every flag (releaseReady, publicReleaseScrubRequired, installDemoWorkflowPending, repoScrubPending, claimLedgerActive, broadPublicClaimsGranted, trainingEligible, programbenchExecutedFromClaudeLane, programbenchImportedFromClaudeLane, programbenchScannedFromClaudeLane, sourceMutationAuthorized) is a compile-time CONSTANT (not derived from props). Required testids: release-ready-badge with data-value='false', public-release-scrub-required, install-demo-workflow-pending, repo-scrub-pending, claim-ledger-active (references CLAUDE_PUBLIC_CLAIMS_LEDGER_LOCK_001), evidence-reconciliation-status (default mentions WORKSPACE_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION_PASSED), broad-public-claims-granted, training-eligible (data-training-eligible='false'), programbench-status ('NOT executed, NOT imported, NOT scanned (unless separately gated)'), source-mutation-authorized ('no source mutation authorized unless a separate proper approval gate supplies it'). Captions: 'This panel REPORTS status. It does NOT authorize release, source mutation, or training.' + 'Ready does NOT mean authorized.' + 'Training stays false (training_eligible: false).'. Tests forbid invokeUnifiedProductCommand calls and any per-prop flag override (props.releaseReady, if (props.releaseReady), etc.).
